name: Planoly
description: Planoly is a visual social media planning and scheduling product for creators, small businesses, and agencies. It combines cross-platform calendars, media organization, publishing, analytics, social engagement, and link-in-bio commerce.
agentUseSummary: Planoly is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Its current first-party site and Help Center document the end-user web and mobile product, social-network connections, and Planoly's own use of third-party platform APIs, but publish no customer-facing Planoly API, developer credential flow, authorized integration programme, or service contract that Relay can implement.

capabilities.label: Plan social content
capabilities.description: After Planoly publishes or approves an integration contract, plan and review social calendars, media, posts, publishing state, and analytics within the provider-approved surface.

blocked.label: Connect without a Planoly API contract
blocked.description: Planoly publishes no customer-facing API authentication, developer credential, scope, token, callback, revocation, or rate-limit contract for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Use private APIs or browser sessions
blocked.description: Relay will not reverse engineer the web or mobile product, reuse cookies or passwords, automate browser sessions, call undocumented endpoints, or bypass the provider interface.

blocked.label: Access Planoly or linked social data
blocked.description: Accounts, users, workspaces, social sets, linked profiles, tokens, calendars, drafts, captions, media, analytics, comments, DMs, customers, orders, and billing data are unavailable before provider authorization.

blocked.label: Publish or administer Planoly
blocked.description: Scheduling, publishing, uploads, social engagement, Link in Bio, Creator Store, team, integration, account, subscription, and deletion actions are unavailable before provider authorization.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider API contract required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until Planoly supplies or approves a public integration contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: Planoly remains visible for product discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable without a provider-approved API contract.
Planoly remains visible for product discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable without a provider-approved API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Current first-party Planoly materials document only the end-user product and Planoly-managed connections to Linked Services. They provide no public Planoly developer API, integration application, customer credential flow, authorized origins or operations, lifecycle, rate limits, test environment, or third-party service terms. The Terms require access through the interface Planoly provides and prohibit reverse engineering or attempts to obtain unauthorized access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Planoly support for written confirmation of whether a third-party integration programme exists. If Planoly approves Relay, obtain the production API reference, authentication and credential lifecycle, scopes, callback and revocation rules, allowed operations, privacy terms, rate limits, test workspace, and live acceptance process before implementing any Railway broker or runtime actions.

evidence.supports: Planoly's current product scope: cross-platform planning, scheduling, media library, social automation, link-in-bio commerce, and analytics, presented through the Planoly end-user product rather than a developer API.
The current Help Center describes web/mobile workspaces, supported social platforms, plans, users, social connections, and support; it exposes no customer-facing developer or API workflow.

Planoly describes its own collection of linked-service access tokens, social identities, creator content, engagement, account, billing, and support data, confirming the sensitivity of any hypothetical integration surface.
Planoly grants a personal non-transferable software license, prohibits reverse engineering and unauthorized access, and requires access through the interface Planoly provides.

securityNotes: Relay does not infer that Planoly's use of Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, or other third-party APIs creates a customer-facing Planoly API.
No password, cookie, browser session, linked-social token, mobile token, private endpoint, traffic capture, or undocumented service may be used to connect Planoly.

All account, workspace, team, social-set, profile, token, calendar, draft, caption, media, analytics, comment, DM, customer, order, billing, publishing, and administration operations remain unavailable.

The Marketplace entry is preview-only until Planoly provides written authorization and a complete production integration contract; provider approval is a terminal prerequisite, not an invitation to emulate the Planoly user interface.
